_doc: arch025-engine design v3: the cut. layer: an edge (call or data use) may only point to a LOWER layer, to the module itself, or to core.shared (Engine-owned state used by >= 3 component modules, handed to each component by a per-member reference listed in modules[m].refs). Every other member is OWNED by one module (data) even when Engine holds it at its declared position ('placed state', DESIGN 2.5). Checked by graph3.py; census3.py reads classes / holders / aliases / free_funcs / files / users.
